projects.name: Portfolio Website
details: Built and deployed a portfolio site with automated CI/CD and AWS static hosting.
Configured HTTPS and custom domain using AWS CloudFront and Route 53.
Tech: Vite, React, TypeScript, GitHub Actions, AWS S3, CloudFront, Route 53, Node.js

projects.name: MEAN Stack Full-Stack Conversion, SNHU
details: Rebuilt a static site into a dynamic full-stack app with MongoDB, Node, Express, and Angular.
Created RESTful APIs and admin interface for content management.
Tech: MongoDB, Express.js, Angular, Node.js, Mongoose, Handlebars, HTML/CSS

projects.name: OpenGL 3D Scene, SNHU
details: Developed a 3D scene using C++ and OpenGL with custom geometry and shaders.
Implemented lighting, textures, and object transformations via the programmable pipeline.

projects.name: Computer Science Capstone, SNHU
details: Improved projects by refactoring code, optimizing algorithms, and securing database queries.
Upgraded BST to AVL tree and modularized OpenGL graphics code
Tech: C++, SQL, SQLite, OpenGL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript

projects.name: Simplifying a Radical – WebAssembly App
details: Created a math app combining C++ logic compiled to WebAssembly for in-browser use.
Built a simple frontend and hosted on Render for easy access.
Tech: C++, JavaScript, WebAssembly, HTML/CSS, Emscripten, Node.js, Render
